% titlesec's option largestsep: a section right after a part has the
% larger of the part's space below and its own space above, as titlesec
% adds its space with \addvspace there.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[largestsep]{titlesec}
\titlespacing*{\section}{0pt}{6ex plus 1ex minus .2ex}{2.5ex plus .2ex}
\begin{document}
Some text before the first part.
\part{Beginnings}
\section{After the part}
Some text in the section.
\end{document}
